name: GFMBenchmark
description: Graph foundation models (GFM) aim to acquire transferable knowledge by pre-training on diverse graphs, which can be adapted to various downstream tasks. However, domain shift in graphs is inherently two-dimensional: graphs differ not only in what they describe (topic domains) but also in how they are represented (format domains). Most existing GFM benchmarks vary only topic domains, thereby obscuring how knowledge transfers across both dimensions.
